name: skill-coach
description: Before each prompt is sent, researches how to prompt the model in your window and your kind of task, finds the skills that fit (installed, or reliable ones online), and offers one rewritten prompt that combines them, for you to send, edit or skip.

model.title: Rewriting model
model.description: The model that researches the prompting guides and rewrites each prompt. Sonnet writes good prompts at a moderate speed; Haiku is faster and cheaper; Opus is slowest and uses the most of your plan.

minChars.title: Shortest prompt to check
minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are sent without a check.
